points.title: 早年生活与法律学习
points.description: 莫里哀出生于巴黎一个富裕的室内陈设商家庭，原名让-巴蒂斯特·波克兰。他按照父亲期望在克莱蒙中学接受良好教育，后进入奥尔良大学学习法律，并于1642年获得律师资格。然而，莫里哀对法律职业毫无兴趣，反而对戏剧充满热情。这段时期他接触了古典文学和意大利即兴喜剧，为他后来的创作奠定了基础。1643年，他放弃了法律职业，与朋友共同创办了'光耀剧团'，开始了他的戏剧生涯。
points.descriptionEn: Molière was born in Paris to a wealthy family of upholsterers, originally named Jean-Baptiste Poquelin. He received a good education at the Collège de Clermont and later studied law at the University of Orléans, becoming a lawyer in 1642. However, Molière had no interest in the legal profession and was passionate about theater instead. During this period, he was exposed to classical literature and Italian commedia dell'arte, which laid the foundation for his future works. In 1643, he abandoned his legal career and co-founded the 'Illustre Théâtre' with friends, beginning his theatrical journey.

points.title: 流浪剧团岁月
points.description: 剧团成立初期遭遇失败，莫里哀因此负债入狱。获释后，他加入了其他剧团，开始了长达13年的外省巡演生涯。这段时期，他走遍了法国南部和西南部，积累了丰富的表演经验，并开始创作自己的剧本。他模仿意大利即兴喜剧的风格，创作了多部喜剧作品，如《滑稽幻想》和《爱情的埋怨》。这段经历使莫里哀深入了解了法国各阶层的社会生活，为日后创作现实主义喜剧提供了丰富的素材和灵感。
points.descriptionEn: The troupe initially failed, and Molière was imprisoned for debt. After his release, he joined other troupes and began a 13-year period of touring the provinces. During this time, he traveled throughout southern and southwestern France, accumulating extensive performance experience and began writing his own plays. He imitated the style of Italian commedia dell'arte, creating comedies such as 'The Amorous Imaginary' and 'The School of Husbands.' This experience allowed Molière to deeply understand the social life of various French classes, providing rich material and inspiration for his later realistic comedies.

points.title: 重返巴黎与宫廷认可
points.titleEn: Return to Paris and Royal Favor
points.description: 1658年，莫里哀的剧团在巴黎为王室演出，获得了路易十四的赏识。他们开始在王宫演出，随后在黎塞留红衣主教的支持下，获得了在巴黎小波旁剧院的演出权。这一时期，莫里哀创作了《可笑的女才子》，讽刺了当时流行的沙龙文化和矫揉造作的贵族语言，获得了巨大成功。然而，该剧也引起了争议，被批评为粗俗和不道德。莫里哀开始与王室的密切联系，成为路易十四的'御用喜剧演员'，这为他提供了创作自由和保护，但也使他不得不迎合宫廷品味。
points.descriptionEn: In 1658, Molière's troupe performed for the royal family in Paris and gained the favor of Louis XIV. They began performing at the royal palace and, with the support of Cardinal Richelieu, obtained the right to perform at the Petit-Bourbon theater in Paris. During this period, Molière wrote 'The Precious Maidens Ridiculed,' satirizing the popular salon culture and affected aristocratic language, achieving great success. However, the play also caused controversy, criticized as vulgar and immoral. Molière developed close ties with the royal court, becoming Louis XIV's 'official comedian,' which provided him with creative freedom and protection but also required him to cater to court tastes.

points.title: 创作巅峰与社会批判
points.description: 这一时期是莫里哀创作生涯的巅峰，他创作了一系列杰作，包括《伪君子》、《唐璜》、《愤世者》和《吝啬鬼》。这些作品深刻批判了当时社会的虚伪、宗教伪善、贵族堕落和资产阶级贪婪。《伪君子》因讽刺宗教伪善而遭到教会强烈反对，被巴黎大主教禁止演出；《唐璜》因挑战宗教权威而被迫修改结尾。尽管面临压力，莫里哀坚持创作，他的作品不仅获得了商业成功，也赢得了知识分子的尊重。这一时期，莫里哀剧团搬进了皇家宫殿的专门剧院，进一步巩固了他在法国戏剧界的地位。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the peak of Molière's career, during which he created a series of masterpieces including 'Tartuffe,' 'Don Juan,' 'The Misanthrope,' and 'The Miser.' These works profoundly criticized the hypocrisy of society, religious piety, aristocratic decadence, and bourgeois greed. 'Tartuffe' was strongly opposed by the church for satirizing religious hypocrisy and was banned by the Archbishop of Paris; 'Don Juan' was forced to have its ending modified for challenging religious authority. Despite the pressure, Molière persisted in his writing, and his works achieved commercial success while earning the respect of intellectuals. During this time, Molière's troupe moved to a dedicated theater in the royal palace, further consolidating his position in French theater.

points.title: 晚年创作与逝世
points.description: 晚年时期，莫里哀的创作风格有所变化，更加注重道德教化和人性探索。他创作了《史嘉本的诡计》、《贵人迷》和《没病找病》等作品，继续以幽默和讽刺揭示社会问题。1673年2月17日，莫里哀在演出《没病找病》时，扮演一个患重病的角色，因肺病发作而倒在了舞台上。他坚持演出到最后一刻，拒绝中断演出，体现了对戏剧艺术的执着。莫里哀的去世被视为法国文学的重大损失，他的作品对后世戏剧和文学产生了深远影响，被翻译成多种语言，在世界各地广泛演出。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Molière's style evolved, placing greater emphasis on moral education and human exploration. He created works such as 'The Miserly,' 'The Would-Be Gentleman,' and 'The Imaginary Invalid,' continuing to use humor and satire to reveal social issues. On February 17, 1673, while performing in 'The Imaginary Invalid,' playing a character suffering from a serious illness, Molière collapsed on stage due to a pulmonary attack. He insisted on performing until the very end, refusing to interrupt the show, demonstrating his dedication to the dramatic arts. Molière's death was considered a great loss to French literature, and his works had a profound influence on later theater and literature, being translated into multiple languages and performed worldwide.

supporter.zh: 莫里哀被誉为法国喜剧的奠基人，他的作品以其精湛的讽刺艺术和对人性的深刻洞察而著称。他通过喜剧形式揭露社会虚伪，挑战权威，为法国戏剧开辟了现实主义道路。莫里哀的喜剧不仅娱乐观众，更具有教育意义，他巧妙地将道德教化融入幽默之中，使观众在欢笑中反思社会问题。他对法国语言和戏剧形式的革新影响深远，被视为法国文学史上最伟大的剧作家之一，其作品至今仍在世界各地舞台上上演。
supporter.en: Molière is celebrated as the founder of French comedy, renowned for his masterful satire and profound insight into human nature. Through comedy, he exposed social hypocrisy, challenged authority, and pioneered a realistic approach to French theater. Molière's works not only entertained audiences but also carried educational value, skillfully integrating moral lessons with humor, prompting reflection on social issues through laughter. His innovations in French language and dramatic form had a profound and lasting impact, establishing him as one of the greatest playwrights in French literary history, with his works still performed worldwide today.

critic.zh: 批评者认为莫里哀的作品存在明显的局限性，他过于依赖讽刺和夸张，缺乏对复杂人性的全面呈现。他的喜剧往往带有明显的道德说教色彩，人物形象扁平化，缺乏深度。此外，莫里哀对贵族和教会的批判虽然勇敢，但有时过于简化，未能触及社会问题的根本原因。他的作品也因其对传统价值观的挑战而受到保守派的攻击，认为他败坏了社会道德。尽管如此，这些批评未能掩盖莫里哀作品的伟大价值，他的喜剧艺术至今仍被广泛研究和欣赏。
critic.en: Critics argue that Molière's works have significant limitations, relying too heavily on satire and exaggeration without fully presenting the complexity of human nature. His comedies often feature obvious moral didacticism, with flat characterizations lacking depth. Furthermore, while Molière's critiques of aristocracy and the church were courageous, they sometimes oversimplified issues without addressing root causes of social problems. His works were also attacked by conservatives for challenging traditional values, accused of corrupting social morality. Nevertheless, these criticisms cannot diminish the great value of Molière's works, whose comedic art continues to be widely studied and appreciated.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，莫里哀被定义为法国古典主义戏剧的代表人物，他的作品体现了17世纪法国社会的价值观和矛盾。莫里哀的喜剧超越了时代限制，成为世界文化遗产的一部分，他的名字已成为讽刺喜剧的代名词。在流行文化中，莫里哀的形象经常被重塑，从严肃的剧作家到机智的讽刺家，反映了不同时代对艺术和社会批判的理解。他的作品不仅影响了后来的戏剧家，也对现代喜剧、电影和电视产生了深远影响，证明了伟大艺术作品的持久生命力。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Molière is defined as a representative of French classical theater, with his works reflecting the values and contradictions of 17th-century French society. Molière's comedies have transcended their time, becoming part of world cultural heritage, and his name has become synonymous with satirical comedy. In popular culture, Molière's image has been frequently reimagined—from serious playwright to witty satirist—reflecting different eras' understandings of art and social criticism. His works have not only influenced later playwrights but also had a profound impact on modern comedy, film, and television, demonstrating the enduring vitality of great artistic works.

self.zh: 喜剧的目的是通过笑来纠正人类的缺点。
self.en: The aim of comedy is to correct by amusing.

others.zh: 莫里哀是法国最伟大的天才，他比任何人都更懂得如何取悦观众，同时又教育他们。
others.en: Molière is the greatest genius France has produced; he knew better than anyone else how to please the public while at the same time instructing them.
